messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature

message.content:
**Short answer:** If you’re looking for the *sweet spot*—great weather, fewer crowds, and reasonable prices—**late April through early June** (and again **late September through early November**) are usually the best times to visit Hawaii. --- ## Why those windows work well | Month | What you’ll experience | |-------|------------------------| | **Late April – Early June** | • Mild temperatures (70–80 °F / 21–27 °C)
• Lower humidity
• Less rain than the winter months
• Fewer tourists than the summer peak
• Good for beach days, hiking, and outdoor activities | | **Late September – Early November** | • Warm, sunny days (80–85 °F / 27–29 °C)
• Cooler evenings
• Still relatively dry
• Fewer crowds after the summer rush
• Great for snorkeling, whale‑watching (Oct–Nov), and cultural festivals | ### What to consider | Factor | Best month(s) | Why | |--------|---------------|-----| | **Crowds & Prices** | Late Apr–Jun, Late Sep–Nov | These are shoulder seasons—tourism is still high enough to keep prices reasonable, but not at the peak of summer or holiday periods. | | **Weather** | Late Apr–Jun, Late Sep–Nov | Temperatures stay comfortable, humidity is moderate, and rainfall is lower than in the winter months (Dec–Feb). | | **Surf & Water Sports** | Winter (Dec–Feb) for big waves; Summer (Jun–Aug) for calmer waters | If you’re a surfer, the winter months bring the best waves on the North Shore. For families and beginners, summer offers calmer, warmer waters. | | **Events & Festivals** | Various | - **Mardi Gras (Feb)** in Honolulu
- **Aloha Festivals (Sept)** on Oʻahu
- **Hawaiian Food & Wine Festival (Oct)** on Maui
- **Lanai International Film Festival (Oct)** | Check the calendar if you want to catch a particular event. | | **Wildlife** | Oct–Nov for humpback whales | Whale‑watching season peaks in October and November. | --- ## Quick reference: Average temperatures (Honolulu) | Month | Avg. High | Avg. Low | |-------|-----------|----------| | April | 81 °F (27 °C) | 66 °F (19 °C) | | May | 83 °F (28 °C) | 68 °F (20 °C) | | June | 84 °F (29 °C) | 69 °F (21 °C) | | September | 84 °F (29 °C) | 70 °F (21 °C) | | October | 82 °F (28 °C) | 68 °F (20 °C) | | November | 80 °F (27 °C) | 66 °F (19 °C) | *(These averages come from NOAA’s climate data for Honolulu.)* --- ## Bottom line - **Best overall**: **Late April–Early June** or **Late September–Early November**. - **If you want the warmest, most crowded summer vibe**: **July–August** (but expect higher prices). - **If you’re chasing surf or whale watching**: **Winter (Dec–Feb)** or **October–November** respectively. Pick the window that matches your priorities—weather, budget, crowd tolerance, and the activities you’re most excited about—and you’ll have a fantastic Hawaiian getaway!
